speaker: narrator
voice_style: Warm and curious, like opening an old storybook at night
text: One night, a human baby walked into a wolf family's home. He laughed. What a brave baby! Then a huge head filled the door. It was Shere Khan, the tiger.

speaker: Shere Khan
voice_style: Deep, grumpy voice of a proud tiger, slow and loud
text: "That baby is mine. Give him to me!"

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Quick, the mother springs into action
text: Mother Wolf jumped up:

speaker: Mother Wolf
voice_style: Strong and protective, every word firm
text: "No! He is mine now. Go away!"

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Steady storyteller voice, a little mysterious at the Council Rock
text: The door was too small for the tiger, so he left. Mother Wolf named the boy Mowgli, the little frog, and protected him. But the law said two animals had to speak for him at the Council Rock. Baloo the bear spoke first. Then Bagheera the black panther paid a price: a fat bull. So Mowgli became one of the wolves. But in the dark, Shere Khan was still shouting.

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Calm but serious, like a secret is coming
text: Ten years later, Mowgli was a strong boy. But Akela, the leader of the wolves, was old and weak. Shere Khan made friends with the young wolves, and they followed him.

speaker: Bagheera
voice_style: Soft, smooth panther voice, worried but wise
text: "Shere Khan is your enemy. When Akela misses a kill, the young wolves will turn against him and you. Get the Red Flower!"

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Faster and faster, a chase in the night
text: That night, the young wolves made Akela go after a big, strong animal. Akela missed! It was a trap. Mowgli ran down to a village and took a small pot of fire. Fire was the Red Flower. The wolves met at the Council Rock. Shere Khan walked among them.

speaker: Shere Khan
voice_style: Sly and smooth, sure that he will win
text: "The leader's place is open now, so I..."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Slow, quiet build-up, stop right on the last word
text: Mowgli held the fire pot and stood up.

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Cozy and spooky-fun, like a campfire story
text: Ichabod Crane was a tall, thin teacher in Sleepy Hollow. He and strong Brom Bones both liked Katrina. At Katrina's autumn party, people told ghost stories. Brom laughed:

speaker: Brom Bones
voice_style: Loud, proud and playful, like he loves showing off
text: "The Headless Horseman? I raced him once! He disappeared at the church bridge."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Slow and quiet, then speeding up like galloping horses
text: Ichabod rode home alone. A rider on a black horse came next to him. He had no head! He carried his head in front of him. He chased Ichabod.

speaker: Ichabod
voice_style: Shaky, nervous, talking fast to himself
text: "If I can cross that bridge, I am safe!"

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Big sound effect, then a quiet, puzzled morning voice
text: He crossed it, but the rider threw his head at him. Crash! The next morning, Ichabod was gone. People found his hat and a broken pumpkin near the bridge. And Brom always laughed at the word "pumpkin."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Bright London morning, a little funny
text: Mr. Wilson had bright red hair. His helper, Vincent, showed him a strange job in the newspaper. It was for red-haired men only! Every day, Wilson copied a big book from ten to two, and he got four pounds a week. But one morning, the office door was locked. A small card was on it.

speaker: Card
voice_style: Short and flat, like reading a sign aloud
text: "The Red-Headed League is closed."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Curious detective voice
text: Wilson told Holmes everything. His helper worked for half pay and often went down to a room under the shop. Holmes went to the shop. He hit the street with his stick and looked at the helper's knees. Then he walked around the corner and looked at a big bank.

speaker: Holmes
voice_style: Calm, sharp and a little mysterious
text: "Watson, come with me tonight. It may be dangerous."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Low, quiet, like walking into a dark room
text: That night, Holmes, Watson, a police officer, and a bank manager went down under the bank. It was a big, dark room full of boxes.

speaker: Bank Manager
voice_style: Proud but nervous, whispering
text: "These boxes are full of French gold."

speaker: Holmes
voice_style: Very quiet, serious
text: "Now we wait in the dark."

speaker: narrator
voice_style: Slow and tense, then a sudden surprise
text: Holmes turned off his light. They waited for more than an hour. Nobody moved. Then Watson saw a small light in the stone floor. A white hand came up between the stones! A big stone turned over, and there was a square hole. A young face looked out. Holmes jumped and caught him. Holmes had seen that face before.
